questions.text: The way a word is said out loud is how it is _____.
Animals that live in the wild, away from people, are called _____.
Something that lasts forever is said to be _____.
When a child runs and jumps happily, she is said to _____.
To get something ready is to _____ it.
When two things mix together, they _____.
Things that are not together are _____.
The top or outside part of something is its _____.
When something winds around another thing, it _____.
When two things are joined together, they are _____.
To break or split something is to _____ it.
A place that protects from wind and rain is _____.
Someone who is very tired is _____.
An animal's skin is called its _____.
The talent for using words to be funny is called _____.
Steps you follow in the same way each time are called _____.
To stir a fire to keep it burning is to _____ it.
Something that is wild or noisy is _____.
All around a place is the _____ area.
Something that is different or surprising is _____.
Use the word Pronounced in a sentence.
questions.answer: The teacher pronounced every word so clearly that everyone could understand.

questions.text: Use the word Sheltered in a sentence.
questions.answer: The children played in the sheltered garden where the wind could not reach them.

questions.text: Use the word Stubborn in a sentence.
questions.answer: My friend is so stubborn that she refuses to change her answer even when proven wrong.

questions.text: Use the word Remarkable in a sentence.
questions.answer: The pilot made a remarkable landing despite the stormy weather.

questions.text: Use the word Mingles in a sentence.
questions.answer: At the party, she walks around and mingles with all the guests.
